rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card's value is pressure applied EARLY — a cheap creature whose rate beats its cost, a one-mana burn spell, a haste threat, an aggressive equipment — so a deck accumulating it wants to end the game before the opponent's expensive cards matter. NOT: a big creature that happens to attack well (that is `ramp` or `reanimator` depending on how it gets into play), and NOT efficient interaction that merely buys time — removal held up for the opponent's threats is `control`.

gloss.when: Cheap pressure that wants the game over early.
gloss.not: A big attacker (ramp/reanimator) or removal held up for threats (control).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card IS an artifact whose draft value is partly the artifact-count column it fills, or it is a payoff whose cost/effect scales with artifacts (Metalcraft, affinity, an artifact tutor, artifact recursion). NOT: an artifact whose text has nothing to do with artifacts and whose rate stands alone — a colourless removal wand belongs to whatever plan its EFFECT serves; the type line alone is not the archetype.

gloss.when: An artifact that fills the count, or a payoff that scales with artifacts.
gloss.not: An artifact whose text ignores artifacts — tag the plan its effect serves.

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card exiles and returns a permanent (flicker), or bounces and replays it, to re-buy an enters-the-battlefield effect — Flickerwisp, Phelia, Displacer Kitten, Ephemerate — or it is a creature whose enters trigger is the reason a flicker deck drafts it (Skyclave Apparition, Thraben Inspector, Solitude). NOT: an enters trigger on a card that only ever enters once and is drafted for its rate (tag the plan its effect serves — `control` for a removal body, `aggro` for a cheap threat), and NOT a cheat that puts a creature from hand into play — that is `cheat`.

gloss.when: Flickers or re-buys enters triggers, or is the trigger a flicker deck wants.
gloss.not: A one-time enters trigger drafted for rate, or a cheat from hand (cheat).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card puts a big creature or artifact onto the battlefield from HAND or LIBRARY without paying its cost — Sneak Attack, Show and Tell, Through the Breach, Tinker, Natural Order, Oath of Druids — or it is a payoff whose whole draft case is being cheated that way (Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, Blightsteel Colossus, Atraxa). NOT: a graveyard-to-battlefield effect or its enablers (`reanimator`, a sibling plan sharing the fatties), and NOT mana acceleration that CASTS the big card early (`ramp`) — the axis is skipping the cost, not paying it sooner.

gloss.when: Puts a fatty into play from hand or library for free, or is that fatty.

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card's ceiling is being one named half of an intentional two-card loop, or the tutor/protection that assembles and defends one (Painter's Servant, Grindstone, a tutor whose best target is a combo piece). NOT: a card that merely wins a long game on its own (`control`), and NOT a critical-mass engine where no single partner is named — that is `storm`. A SPECIFIC, signed two-card pairing is a Combo Edge on the profile, not an archetype tag; this tag says the card LIVES in that kind of deck.

gloss.when: One named half of a two-card loop, or the tutor that assembles it.
gloss.not: A long-game finisher (control) or a critical-mass engine (storm).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card trades for more than it costs over a long game — counterspells, one-for-more removal, sweepers, card draw, a win condition that needs the game to go long. NOT: cheap interaction whose job is to clear a blocker for an early attack (`aggro`), and NOT a card whose card advantage comes from the graveyard rather than the library (`graveyard`).

gloss.when: Trades for more than it costs over a long game.
gloss.not: Interaction that clears the way for an attack (aggro), or graveyard card advantage (graveyard).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the graveyard is a RESOURCE the card fills or spends — self-mill, flashback/escape/delve, a discard outlet, a card that scales with graveyard size, graveyard hate. NOT: a card whose only graveyard interaction is returning a single fat creature to the battlefield (`reanimator`, the narrower plan), and NOT a death trigger on a creature that simply dies in combat — that is a Capability (`value-on-death`), not a plan.

gloss.when: Fills or spends the graveyard as a resource.
gloss.not: Returning one fatty to play (reanimator), or a plain death trigger (a Capability).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card treats LANDS as a resource beyond one drop a turn — extra land plays, lands played or returned from the graveyard, landfall payoffs, lands sacrificed for value, a payoff scaling with land cards in the graveyard (Fastbond, Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, Mole Man, Titania). NOT: a card that only ramps by fetching a land onto the battlefield once (`ramp`), and NOT a fetch or dual land drafted for its colours — the type line alone is not the plan.

gloss.when: Lands as a resource: extra plays, landfall, land recursion, land sacrifice.
gloss.not: A one-shot land fetch (ramp) or a land drafted for colours.

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card either produces mana ahead of the curve (mana rock, mana dork, land fetch, a cost reducer) or is a payoff expensive enough that a deck only casts it because it ramped. NOT: a cheap artifact whose value is the artifact COUNT rather than the mana (`artifacts`), and NOT a card that skips paying the cost entirely by putting a creature into play from hand or graveyard — cheating is `cheat`/`reanimator`, not acceleration.

gloss.when: Mana ahead of the curve, or a payoff only castable after ramping.
gloss.not: A cheap artifact counted for its type (artifacts), or cheating a cost entirely (reanimator/combo).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card is one end of the put-a-fatty-into-play-early plan — a graveyard-to-battlefield effect, a discard/self-mill enabler chosen FOR that plan, or a creature whose whole draft case is being cheated in. NOT: generic graveyard value, recursion of small cards, or flashback (`graveyard`, the wider plan), and NOT a cheat from hand or library (`cheat`). The card-to-card half of this — whether a specific fatty is actually retrievable — is the `reanimatable` Capability, not this tag.

gloss.when: One end of putting a fatty into play early from the graveyard.
gloss.not: Generic graveyard value, small-card recursion or flashback (graveyard).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card is a free or repeatable sacrifice OUTLET that turns its own permanents into value (Goblin Bombardment, Carnage Interpreter's investigate, Bone Shards' cost), or a payoff that rewards permanents dying or being sacrificed (Skullclamp, a Blood Artist shape). NOT: a creature that merely has a death trigger — that is the `value-on-death` Capability, a card-to-card fact, not a plan — and NOT an edict that makes the OPPONENT sacrifice (`control`).

gloss.when: A sacrifice outlet or a payoff for your own permanents dying.
gloss.not: A lone death trigger (Capability) or an edict on the opponent (control).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card pays off CASTING instants and sorceries or several spells a turn across a normal game — prowess, flurry, a second-spell trigger, magecraft, cost reduction for noncreature spells (Monastery Swiftspear, Ledger Shredder, Cori-Steel Cutter, Third Path Iconoclast) — or it is a cheap cantrip such a deck plays for the count. NOT: a critical mass of spells to win in ONE turn (`storm`), and NOT a counterspell or removal spell drafted to answer threats (`control`) — the axis is a steady stream of triggers, not one big turn.

gloss.when: Pays off casting instants/sorceries or two spells a turn.
gloss.not: One explosive turn (storm) or interaction drafted to answer threats (control).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card contributes to, or pays off, a CRITICAL MASS of spells cast in one turn — rituals, free/near-free spells, cost reducers aimed at a single turn, and the payoffs that count them. NOT: a named two-card loop (`combo`), and NOT mana acceleration meant to cast one expensive spell a turn early (`ramp`) — the axis here is spell COUNT within a turn, not mana available across turns.

gloss.when: Adds to or pays off many spells cast in one turn.
gloss.not: A named two-card loop (combo) or acceleration for one big spell (ramp).

rows.description: TAG WHEN: the card creates two or more creature tokens, or keeps making them, so a deck accumulating it goes WIDE — Lingering Souls, Forth Eorlingas!, Elspeth, Legion Extruder — or it is an anthem/payoff counting creatures or tokens. NOT: a single token as a side effect of a removal or card-draw spell (tag the plan the main effect serves), and NOT an investigate/Treasure/Clue token — those are not creatures and feed `artifacts` or `ramp`.

gloss.when: Makes several creature tokens, or pays off going wide.
gloss.not: One incidental token, or non-creature Clue/Treasure tokens.
